SELECT r.id, r.goal_id, r.title, r.duration_minutes, r.created_at, r.updated_at
FROM studyhub.learning_records r
INNER JOIN studyhub.goals g ON r.goal_id = g.id
WHERE g.user_id = #{userId}
AND r.title LIKE CONCAT( '%', #{learningRecordPageQueryDTO.title}, '%' )
AND r.goal_id = #{learningRecordPageQueryDTO.goalId}
ORDER BY r.id DESC
